description: This header defines the 'CmduClient' class, a component for sending and receiving CMDU messages between local processes, including event handler setup, message forwarding, and connection management.

classes.name: CmduClient
classes.description: A class providing an interface for CMDU message communication, including event handling and message forwarding.

methods.name: set_handlers
methods.description: Sets callback functions for CMDU received and connection closed events.

methods.name: clear_handlers
methods.description: Clears all previously set event handler functions.

methods.name: send_cmdu
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message to the connected server.

methods.name: forward_cmdu
methods.description: Forwards a received CMDU message to a server.

methods.name: get_fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the client.
